title: Morning at Marigold Coffee
character: Woman in her 30s, shoulder-length black hair tied loosely, warm brown eyes, mustard-yellow apron over white linen shirt, small silver ring on right hand.
environment: Small neighbourhood coffee shop, early morning. Large window camera-left with soft daylight, worn wooden counter, brass espresso machine, chalkboard menu behind counter, two potted plants on the sill.

shots.lighting: soft morning window light from camera-left, warm practical pendant lamps over the counter
shots.composition: rule of thirds, counter on lower third, window left, depth to the back wall
shots.action: The empty shop at dawn; steam rises from the espresso machine as lights flicker on.

shots.reason: draw the viewer toward her as the shop comes alive
shots.lighting: window light camera-left as key, lamp fill from above the counter
shots.composition: left third, look room toward the machine on the right
shots.action: She ties her apron, glances at the first order ticket, small focused exhale.

shots.lighting: backlit by the window, steam catching the light
shots.action: Espresso streams into a ceramic cup; crema swirls; her ringed hand steadies the cup.

shots.reason: documentary intimacy for the human beat
shots.lighting: window key light camera-left, soft bounce fill from the counter
shots.action: She hands the cup to the first customer, a tired nurse; their eyes meet, a small real smile forms and fades.

shots.reason: closing ascent as the shop fills with morning life
shots.lighting: full morning sun through the window, warm interior lamps
shots.composition: frame within a frame through the front window from outside
shots.action: The shop seen from the street, customers at the counter, chalkboard reads the shop name.
